mutations in genes encoding the ATP-sensitive K+-channel subunits Kir6.2 and SUR1 cause HI in the newborn and that these mutations result in a defect in K+ efflux and insulin release.
the ATP-sensitive K+-channel is a key target for the pathogenesis of hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia in the neonatal period.
